title: mcp: the served MCP skill and TOOL_RETIRED_KEY_GUIDANCE still teach run_action confirm: true, which the MCP door no longer reads since the confirmation hand-off
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTEivi2wogPpeo3xd5

Found by area S3 while delivering #33690 (PR #34202, dev report https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/33690#issuecomment-6904293454, out-of-scope finding class b).

**The contract after PR #34202.** At the MCP door, a call to an action that declares `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` is handed to the host's `IActionConfirmationService` and answered `pending_confirmation`. With no service registered, it is refused 428 `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` with `reason: no_confirmation_service`. The caller's `confirm: true` is accepted and never read (the `ai-service.ts` docblock says so).

**What still teaches the opposite:**
- `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` (the served MCP skill resource, about lines 480–502) tells an agent to send `confirm: true` on `run_action`;
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.ts`, a byte-identical mirror pinned by a mirror test, so it moves in the same change;
- `TOOL_RETIRED_KEY_GUIDANCE` in `packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts`;
- the #33689 changeset says this text moves with the change.

**Reach:** every stack serves that skill resource on its public MCP door, so agents are taught a step that does nothing. About 30 lines across the three files.

**Open design point, for the maintainer:** should the `confirm` member be retired from the `run_action` / `resume_run` input schemas, so that a stale client is refused loudly instead of silently ignored? The dev recommends retiring it now, in this same change. It would be a further narrowing beyond ruling #33690, so it needs a ruling. The seat has it.

Blocked-by: #34202

Prior rulings read: the #33690 ruling (the caller's confirm never counts; hand-off to the host service); the #33689 changeset text.

Dedupe: open-issue searches for "skill-md run_action confirm" and "TOOL_RETIRED_KEY_GUIDANCE confirm" found only #33690.
